facts.statement: The name Acrotholus means "highest dome" in Greek.
facts.quote: Acrotholus (Greek for "highest dome"- akros meaning highest and tholos meaning dome)

facts.statement: The holotype fossil was discovered in 2008 in the Deadhorse Coulee Member of the Milk River Formation in Southern Alberta, Canada.
facts.quote: The holotype was found in the Deadhorse Coulee Member of the Milk River Formation in Southern Alberta, Canada in 2008.

facts.statement: Acrotholus audeti lived approximately 84 million years ago during the Late Cretaceous Santonian stage.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del período Cretácico Superior durante el Santoniense hace aproximadamente 84 millones de años

facts.statement: Unlike most pachycephalosaurs, the dome on A. audeti's skull is oval-shaped with a maximum thickness of 55 mm.
facts.quote: Unlike most known pachycephalosaurs, A. audeti's dome on the skull is oval in shape having a maximum thickness of 55 mm above the cerebral fossa.

facts.statement: The absence of tesserae or tubercles indicates the Acrotholus holotype was an adult or near adult.
facts.quote: The lack of tesserae or tubercles indicate the specimen was past the juvenile stage of its development.

facts.statement: Acrotholus is considered one of the earliest indisputable members of the pachycephalosaur family.
facts.quote: The iconic cranial dome found on Acrotholus makes it one of the earliest indisputable known members of the pachycephalosaur family.

facts.statement: Acrotholus audeti is classified as the sister taxon to Prenocephale prenes.
facts.quote: A. audeti was recovered as the sister taxon to Prenocephale prenes.

facts.statement: Acrotholus is the earliest known pachycephalosaur with derived traits, predating later flat-headed species in Asia.
facts.quote: Acrotholus is the earliest known specimen of pachycephalosaur with derived traits from the fossil records, predating later known species of flat headed species in Asia.

facts.statement: The most widely accepted hypothesis suggests the cranial dome was used as a weapon in intra-species combat.
facts.quote: The more widely accepted and popular hypothesis explains the dome being used as a weapon.

facts.statement: Pathologies like chronic osteomyelitis observed in related pachycephalosaurs suggest the dome was used in combat.
facts.quote: In P. wyomingensis and other examined pachycephalosaur skulls, chronic osteomyelitis was observed, a pathology often associated with combat.

facts.statement: Analysis suggests many pachycephalosaur species, including those near Acrotholus, inhabited coastal areas.
facts.quote: Analysis of pachycephalosaurid skulls by Mallon and Evans, suggest many species frequently inhabited coastal areas contrary to their terrestrial lifestyle.

facts.statement: While the dome is associated with intra-species combat, the exact methods of contact remain debated.
facts.quote: The dome had often been associated with intra-species combat, although the exact methods of contact have been debated.

facts.statement: The evolutionary consolidation between flat-headed and domed pachycephalosaurs is a subject of great debate.
facts.quote: Consolidation between flat headed and domed pachycephalosaurs have been greatly debated.

facts.statement: Pachycephalosaurs are unique for their small size, generally weighing 40 kg or less.
facts.quote: Pachycephalosaurs in general are unique in dinosaur fossil records due to their relatively small size in relation to most dinosaurs in their time period, 40 kg or less.

facts.statement: The body length is estimated at 1.5 to 2 meters with a weight of 40 kilograms.
facts.quote: La longitud del cuerpo se estima en 1,5 a 2 metros, con un peso de 40 kilogramos.

facts.statement: The rear of the parietal bones has a prominent crest along the midline of the top.
facts.quote: La parte posterior de los huesos parietales tiene una cresta llamativa en la línea media de la parte superior.

facts.statement: The skull, formed by the fusion of the frontal and parietal bones, is about 5 centimeters thick.
facts.quote: El cráneo, formado por coalescencia del hueso frontal y los parietales, tiene de unos 5 centímetros de espesor.

facts.statement: The thick skull was likely used for head-butting during fights between males.
facts.quote: El grueso cráneo fue utilizado probablemente para cabezazos durante la lucha entre los machos.

facts.statement: Unlike most known pachycephalosaurs, the skull dome of A. audeti is oval-shaped with a maximum thickness of 55 millimeters above the braincase.
facts.quote: A diferencia de la mayoría de los paquicefalosaurios conocidos, la cúpula del cráneo de A. audeti tiene forma ovalada y un grosor máximo de 55 milímetros por encima de la fosa cerebral.

facts.statement: The lack of tesserae or tubercles indicates the specimen had passed the juvenile stage of its development.
facts.quote: La falta de teselas o tubérculos indica que el espécimen había pasado la etapa juvenil de su desarrollo.

facts.statement: It has been suggested that the dome was covered by very little soft tissue due to structural anatomy and hypothetical use.
facts.quote: Se ha sugerido que la cúpula estaba cubierta por muy poca cantidad de tejido blando debido a la anatomía estructural y al uso hipotético.

facts.statement: In 2008, a small pachycephalosaur skull was found at the edge of the Milk River, Alberta, Canada, one mile east of the Provincial Writing-on-Stone at the foot of a natural pyramid.
facts.quote: En 2008 a orillas del Río Milk, Alberta, Canadá, a una milla al este de la Provincial Writing-on-Stone, al pie de una pirámide natural encontró el cráneo de un pequeño de paquicefalosauriano.

facts.statement: In 2013, the type species Acrotholus audeti was named and described by David Evans, Ryan Schott, Derek Larson, Caleb Marshall Brown, and Michael Ryan.
facts.quote: En 2013, la especie tipo Acrotholus audeti fue nombrada y descrita por David Evans, Ryan Schott, Derek Larson, Caleb Marshall Brown y Michael Ryan.

facts.statement: The genus name derives from ancient Greek akros, meaning "the highest point," and tholos, meaning "reached its highest point roof," referencing the high skull dome.
facts.quote: El nombre del género se deriva del griego antiguo ἄκρος, akros, "el punto más alto" y θόλος, tholos, "alcanzó su punto máximo techo", una referencia a la alta cúpula del cráneo.

facts.statement: The specific name honors Roy Audet, the rancher on whose land the discovery was made.
facts.quote: Los honores específicos hacen referencia a Roy Audet, el ranchero en cuyas tierras se hizo el descubrimiento.

facts.statement: This formation is known to expose organisms from the Late Santonian.
facts.quote: Se sabe que esta formación expone organismos del Santoniano Tardío.

facts.statement: The holotype was found in a layer of the Deadhorse Coulee member of the Milk River Formation dated to the Santonian, approximately 83.5 million years ago.
facts.quote: El holotipo, TMP 2008.045.0001, fue encontrado en una capa del miembro Deadhorse Coulee de la Formación río Milk datada en el Santoniano y que tiene 83,5 millones de años.

facts.statement: It has been suggested that because smaller bones are susceptible to destruction by carnivores and erosion, there is a preservation bias toward smaller species.
facts.quote: Se ha sugerido que debido a que los huesos más pequeños son susceptibles a la destrucción por carnívoros y la erosión, existe un sesgo de preservación para las especies más pequeñas.

facts.statement: Among known fossil specimens, approximately 66% are known only from cranial remains.
facts.quote: Entre los especímenes fósiles conocidos, aproximadamente el 66% se conocen solo a partir de restos craneales.

facts.statement: According to the describers, Acrotholus is considered within Pachycephalosauria, more specifically in Pachycephalosauridae.
facts.quote: Acrotholus según los descriptores se lo considera dentro de Pachycephalosauria más específicamente en Pachycephalosauridae.

facts.statement: Within that group, it occupies a secondary position as a sister species to Prenocephale, forming a branch that reflects a taxon sister to a clade formed by Alaskacephale, Pachycephalosaurus, and Sphaerotholus.
facts.quote: Dentro de ese grupo ocupa una posición más bien secundaria, como especie hermana de Prenocephale, formando juntos una rama que refleja un taxón hermano de un clado formado por Alaskacephale, Pachycephalosaurus y Sphaerotholus.

facts.statement: This is surprising because Acrotholus is one of the oldest known pachycephalosaurs.
facts.quote: Esto es lo sorprendente porque Acrotholus es uno de los más antiguos paquicefalosaurianos conocidos.

facts.statement: The consolidation between flat-headed and domed pachycephalosaurs has been highly debated.
facts.quote: La consolidación entre paquicefalosáuridos de cabeza plana y abovedada ha sido muy debatida.

facts.statement: It has been proposed that some pachycephalosaur species exhibit paedomorphosis.
facts.quote: aunque se ha propuesto que algunas especies de paquicefalosaurio exhiben pedomorfismo.

facts.statement: Acrotholus audeti is characterized by a notable physiology featuring fused frontal and parietal skull bones forming a thickened dome structure.
facts.quote: La fisiología más notable de A. audeti es el cráneo frontal y parietal fusionados que forman una estructura de cúpula engrosada.

facts.statement: The most widely accepted hypothesis suggests the dome was used as a weapon.
facts.quote: La hipótesis más ampliamente aceptada y popular explica que la cúpula se usaba como arma.

facts.statement: Analysis of the dome in Pachycephalosaurus wyomingensis shows pathologies reflecting those seen in modern mammals exhibiting intraspecific contact.
facts.quote: El análisis de la cúpula del espécimen más conocido Pachycephalosaurus wyomingensis muestra algunas patologías en la cúpula que reflejan las de los mamíferos modernos que exhiben contacto intraespecífico.

facts.statement: Chronic osteomyelitis, a pathology often associated with combat, was observed in P. wyomingensis and other examined pachycephalosaur skulls.
facts.quote: En P. wyomingensis y otros cráneos de paquicefalosaurios examinados, se observó osteomielitis crónica, una patología a menudo asociada con el combate.

facts.statement: Several skull specimens show healed lesions suggesting survival after contact.
facts.quote: Varios especímenes de cráneo muestran varias lesiones con curación que sugiere supervivencia después del contacto.

facts.statement: Flat-headed individuals showed little cranial damage, supporting their ontogeny at a juvenile stage.
facts.quote: Los individuos de cabeza plana vieron poco daño craneal que apoya su ontogenia en etapa juvenil.

facts.statement: Analysis of pachycephalosaurid skulls by Mallon and Evans suggests many species frequently inhabited coastal areas rather than a terrestrial lifestyle.
facts.quote: El análisis de cráneos de paquicefalosáuridos por Mallon y Evans sugiere que muchas especies habitaban frecuentemente áreas costeras en contraposición a su estilo de vida terrestre.

facts.statement: The proportions of the hind limbs were found to be similar to modern animals like moose and various wading birds that inhabit wetland areas.
facts.quote: Se ha descubierto que las proporciones de las extremidades traseras son similares a las de otros animales modernos, como el alce y varias aves zancudas que habitan áreas de humedales.

facts.statement: The genus Acrotholus lived from 85.7 to 83.6 million years ago during the Santonian age.
facts.quote: Time range: Santonian to Santonian (85.7 to 83.6 million years ago)

facts.statement: Acrotholus belongs to the parent group Pachycephalosaurinae.
facts.quote: Parent group: Pachycephalosaurinae

facts.statement: Acrotholus is classified within the family Pachycephalosauridae.
facts.quote: Family: Pachycephalosauridae

facts.statement: Acrotholus is classified in the class Ornithischia.
facts.quote: Class: Ornithischia

facts.statement: The genus Acrotholus was named by Evans et al. in 2013.
facts.quote: PBDB name: Acrotholus (genus), Evans et al. 2013
